description:
Most systems around you aren’t built for efficiency.
Grain & Gravity explores simple, overlooked ideas that outperform what you’re told works — from energy and natural systems to hidden mechanics and real-world efficiency.
We break down why they work, what the numbers actually say, and how these ideas can be used in the real world.
Want to go deeper?
Grain & Gravity Field Manuals take our most popular investigations further — with detailed technical breakdowns, real costs, parts lists, calculations and practical guidance that can’t all fit into a video.
Because the simplest solution is usually the one people ignore.
Grain & Gravity — The numbers don’t lie.
